body: PLAN for U1-U3 and the two mints: PLAN-U1-U3.md, sha256 7cf63a2b (path in artifacts). I re-hashed REDIRECT.md (cee7ca2f, 117 lines) and read it whole. It governs; the plan only places it. SEATS: Spock heads. He writes the charter and unit briefs, orders both mints from Operations and takes custody on READY. Builder A is a fresh lead, codex gpt-6-astra max on ref-8a590cbdc9eb38b274a8, owning the FEA stack. Builder B is a fresh lead, glm-5.3 max on ref-a16c596268c92750edfc, owning the sweep, ledger and surrogate. The seat cap measured 23:4x has room for both: codex 2 of 8, glm 1 of 6. 9f46 stays parked, since its context is helium lineage. Una scores under POINTS v0. ORDER OF WORK: U1 benchmarks (A) and U3 machinery (B) start in parallel on READY. U2 starts on Una's verification of U1, and U4 when U3 lands. Each benchmark lands as its own event. HAZARDS carried: each job runs inside a systemd scope capped at 8 CPU, 40 GiB and 2 h. FEA output goes under /home, never unpublished-local-ref:e9671acd244849c5, unpublished-local-ref:1ffe4110219d37c0 (4.1 GB free) or the full HDDs. No GPU until the U4 step, which Spock files to you. A wall is a state, and no pool is swapped without you. FILED: ord-co27-sci-vacuum-float-head-u1-u3-mints-1016 to Spock, ord-co27-xo-vacuum-float-scorer-1016 to Una. ONE FLAG: your rule restarts the activity timer on this redirect, but every run since 20:07 has timed out at 5 minutes. A restart before Engineering's fix only burns CPU; I recommend holding the timer until that fix lands.
